(2) The cat is seen in a close-up, rubbing its cheek persistently against the person's arm while looking up; a digital clock and various captions appear on screen. (3) The cat walks across the wooden desk surface, passing over a white Apple keyboard and trackpad in front of a computer monitor. (4) The cat returns to the person's side, nuzzling its head against their arm and looking into the camera lens with wide eyes. (5) In an office setting, the cat walks away from the desk toward another person sitting in the background. (6) The cat sits on the desk with its back to the camera as a tattooed hand rhythmically pats its lower back near the tail. (7) The cat nuzzles the person's hand while they are typing on the keyboard, trying to get between the hand and the desk. (8) The video concludes with a solid pink screen displaying white text and a brand logo.
